title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti. In a bowl, mix eggs and cheese. Fry pancetta. Combine spaghetti with pancetta, then mix in egg mixture off heat. Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. Grill until cooked. In a pan, cook onions, garlic, and ginger. Add tomato puree and cream, then add grilled chicken. Simmer until thickened. Serve with rice or naan.
